subject.title: fix(gateway): bound BOOT.md file read size

question: Should a BOOT.md larger than 16 MiB fail the boot task visibly or be skipped as empty?
rationale: Both outcomes prevent an unbounded read, but maintainer intent is required to choose between startup availability and operator visibility when configured instructions are not executed.

options.title: Fail visibly
options.body: Return a failed boot result with a clear size-limit reason so operators know their startup instructions did not run.

options.title: Skip as empty
options.body: Preserve gateway availability while accepting that oversized startup instructions may be silently omitted.

recommendation.title: Fail visibly
recommendation.body: Return a failed boot result with a clear size-limit reason so operators know their startup instructions did not run.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the original BOOT.md feature and is the strongest available decision-routing candidate from the central-file history.
